decisions.decision: QUICK_REPLIES read through qrList() = typeof guard returning [] if the global is missing; no local fallback list
decisions.why: AC-14 allows exactly one list literal; a local const would also throw a redeclaration error once BE data.js lands. Alternative (local stub) rejected.

decisions.decision: Mobile rule scoped as #chatIn{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0}; existing .chatbar input{flex:1 1 100%} kept
decisions.why: The dark-cult chat form also uses .chatbar input; replacing the shared rule would change its layout, which is out of scope. Contract said replace the shared rule; this gives the same result for #chatIn.

decisions.decision: Emoji buttons wrapped in .chat-emo{flex:1 1 100%} so the emoji row is always row 2
decisions.why: flex-basis 0 on the input would let emoji share row 1 at 375px; a wrapper makes the layout deterministic.

decisions.decision: render() restores focus for #chatIn (with caret) without writing a value, and for pills (data-qi) and #qrToggle with preventScroll
decisions.why: Root cause of AC-1 was value write-back; pills/toggle are rebuilt each state push so keyboard focus would be lost.

decisions.decision: qrOpen not reset on a new morning
decisions.why: Design says FE may; kept simple, state survives render() only.

decisions.decision: #chatErr placed directly under the form (above the toggle) and the purge hint under the toggle only when limited and not disabled
decisions.why: Errors from pill taps stay visible next to the input; the hint is irrelevant when pills are disabled (note shown instead).

summary: Chat bar built (send btn, Enter-clear fix, 23-pill collapsible panel, disabled states); headless-Chrome check 23/23 pass; npm test: only expected http-parity DIFFs on / /?room /index.html /style.css; other suites pass.
